items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: He's a cousin of Hinton. Yeah, he's still in New York. I talk to him.

ctx.x: Is he still in New York? Yeah.
He's a cousin of Hinton. Yeah, he's still in New York. I talk to him. Let me ask you this, you recorded with Ollie Powers? No, I never wrote. You weren't on that record?
Ollie Powers, I was about to get into this. Yeah, he was a kid. He was a kid.
